html:
Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is a place with its own suburban beauty. Although it is located 35km from Hanoi, it exudes its own beauty. Coming here, visitors will visit a traditional craft village and is a check-in spot chosen by young people.

Right from the village gate, visitors will encounter bundles of incense drying along the road, the sound of bamboo sticks and the clicking sound of incense making machines, a rustic and familiar sound of a craft village.

When mentioning the incense village and conical hat village, you probably think of Hue. Few people know that Quang Phu Cau incense village brings visitors a unique beauty.

The incense village has existed for hundreds of years, initially a side job, but has gradually become a traditional craft village, not only an attractive tourist destination for visitors from all over the world but also brings income to the people here.

Previously, the craft village was handmade, but now it has developed with modern machines, producing good, beautiful products that many tourists visit when traveling to Hanoi, and this is also one of the most strongly developing traditional craft villages.

Currently, the incense village is an attractive tourist destination for many domestic and international tourists, so many factories have also arranged beautiful incense bundles for tourists to check in, thereby promoting the products of the craft village to domestic and international friends.

Many tourists share that although they have traveled everywhere to explore, when visiting the incense village, they will not be able to help but admire the photos of the incense stick production village of Quang Phu Cau, especially when the photos appear on social networks, further urging travelers to come to the incense village.

So to experience those interesting things, come with Vietlook Travel to visit the incense village to visit and experience the beauty of a traditional craft village through the stages of the craft village, and save for yourself unique, colorful photos.
